answer: To resist Sybil attacks, an agent network can enforce verifiable delay functions. Whether tuning an optical prism or tracking wild willow and lotus flora, each identity must solve sequential, non-parallelizable cryptographic puzzles tied to shared entropy. An attacker incurs the scarce cost of dedicating physical single-threaded processor time per identity. However, this approach burdens energy-limited edge nodes and favors adversaries deploying custom ASIC hardware.
